company.name: Beehive
company.shortDescription: Beehive is a UAE-based fintech and digital SME financing platform.
company.description: Beehive is a peer-to-peer (P2P) lending platform that uses cutting-edge technology to connect businesses looking for quick, low-cost financing with investors who can help fund their expansion. Beehive removes the cost and complexity of traditional finance and replaces it with an effective, simplified fundraising method. The platform allows global investors to earn great returns by investing directly in robust, creditworthy firms.

productsAndServices.description: Medium-term business financing for established SMEs, intended for one-off investments such as equipment purchases, expansion, and other growth projects.

productsAndServices.description: Short-term financing that helps SMEs manage cash-flow gaps, fund operating expenses, and cover timing differences between payments and receipts.
productsAndServices.name: Working Capital Finance

productsAndServices.description: A digital peer-to-peer investment platform that connects investors with SME financing opportunities and supports portfolio allocation by product mix, business exposure, and risk rating.
productsAndServices.name: Beehive SME Investment Platform

productsAndServices.description: A digital and analyst-led underwriting service that evaluates SME repayment capacity, ownership, financial data, alternative data, and operational conditions before funding is listed.
productsAndServices.name: SME Credit and Risk Assessment

productsAndServices.description: A guaranteed SME financing scheme delivered with Dubai SME for Dubai-based businesses owned or managed by Emiratis that meet specified financial and operational criteria.
productsAndServices.name: Capital Guarantee Business Funding

productsAndServices.description: Small-business financing for fast cash injections, using fixed repayments to address relatively modest funding needs.
productsAndServices.name: Microfinance
